opening_message:
Ticket 1: Miguel Benson (employee ID E006) requests admin access to Source Code.

Team memory: 2 note(s) about employee E006.
Note 1 (ticket 1), written by HR agent:
  - role: Engineer
  - employment type: contractor
  - recommendation for Source Code: read
  - comment: Miguel Benson (E006) is a contractor Engineer. Contractors can never be granted admin; per policy their maximum is read, or write only with advanced security training. Requested admin exceeds the contractor maximum, so I recommend read (unless security confirms advanced training, then write).
Note 2 (ticket 1), written by Security agent:
  - role: Engineer
  - employment type: contractor
  - security training: basic
  - recommendation for Source Code: read
  - comment: Security record confirms E006 is a contractor Engineer with basic security training. Contractors can never be granted admin; max is read (write only with advanced training). Requested admin exceeds the maximum, so I recommend read.
reason: Miguel Benson (E006) is a contractor Engineer with basic security training. Per policy, contractors can never be granted admin; their maximum is read, or write only with advanced security training. Since training is basic, the maximum allowed level is read.
